title: Sleep beside giraffes at Longneck Manor
description: At Longneck Manor, the Giraffe Suite sits within the giraffe barn, so the animals can be visible beyond the windows even after the day visit ends. Animal-care specialists lead encounters and explain feeding, enrichment, and conservation work. Staying overnight gives you the unusual rhythm of sharing a place with giraffes rather than arriving only for a brief photo.
teaser: Spend the night beside the giraffe barn in Texas.
goodToKnow: Confirm the minimum stay, room access and which animal encounters are included before booking.
whyItMightDelightYou: The quiet moments between scheduled encounters may be the ones that make the animals feel most present.
